names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Василий (Ягодин), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Василия … пресвитеров». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Василия и Александра пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: The first of the two the day’s seventh line names, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGES ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind either of them. The line says «пресвитеров» of both and the name page says «протоиерей», archpriest, of him, so `presbyter` is the line’s word and the office `Archpriest` the name page’s. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Ягодин» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints seven hymns and none is under either name.
